title: Station Commission Record
author: Fleet Commissioning Office, Sindalian High Guard
content:
STATION HG-BORITE-XII
CLASSIFICATION: WATCH OUTPOST, CLASS III
STATUS: COMMISSIONED

Primary function:
— Hydrogen escort, gas skimming operations
— Customs inspection, inbound convoy routes
— Strategic presence, Borite approach corridor

Crew complement: 62 personnel
Command authority: Fleet Watch Command, Sindal Prime

This station exists to remind the outer systems that the Emperor's reach extends to the gutter of his empire.

The Empire endures in orbit.

Endure with it.

title: Commander's Log — Fragment 214
author: Commander Aelys Vorne, HG Watch Station XII
content:
Supply convoy is six weeks overdue.

I have filed eleven incident reports.
I have received zero responses.
I have stopped filing incident reports.

Morale is what it is. The gas giant turns. It is a beautiful world. I have started to wonder what it looks like from inside the atmosphere. Whether you would have time to notice before it killed you.

Fleet Command assures us that reinforcements are—

[LOG ENDS MID-ENTRY]
